plan.quantity: Expected next-token KL regret in bits
plan.crossing: First tested time whose population mean regret is at most target; no interpolation
plan.nonattainment: Keep unreached outcomes in estimates and bootstrap samples
plan.grid_rule: Union of powers of two and ceil(n_B*2^(j/4)),j=-4..4,clipped1..1024; development Bayes only
plan.model_scope: One existing fixed trained checkpoint; no training-seed generalization
plan.stop_rule: All1024 sequences per condition; do not stop for favorable agreement

statistics.method: Fixed-original-SE standardized bootstrap mean deviations; a single maximum across all supplied conditions, predictors and times. Independent whole-sequence resampling across conditions, paired across predictors and times within each condition.
statistics.crossing_rule: First tested time with mean risk <= target, without interpolation or monotonicity enforcement; exact floating-point comparison with no added threshold tolerance.
statistics.uncertainty_scope: Approximate simultaneous confidence bands conditional on the frozen trained model(s). Reference numerical error and between-training-run variation are not included.
statistics.zero_se_rule: Exactly constant empirical coordinates have zero-width bands and zero bootstrap deviation. This is an empirical-bootstrap limitation, not proof of a deterministic population.
statistics.nonattainment: Unreached is categorical beyond the tested grid. Fractions are bootstrap diagnostics, not posterior probabilities. Difference/ratio intervals are absent whenever either compatible set includes nonattainment; no finite-only intervals are reported.
statistics.numerical_rule: Input risks down to -1e-12 are accepted as possible evaluation roundoff and preserved, not clipped. This tolerance is not used for crossing decisions.

uncertainty: Whole-sequence paired bootstrap; one fixed trained model, no training-seed variation
